memberdef.name: INIT_COEIO_FILE
memberdef.initializer: struct coio_file_task name; \ memset(&name, 0, sizeof(name)); \ name.fiber = fiber(); \

briefdescription.para: A callback invoked by eio when a task is complete.
Synchronously (from cooperative multitasking point of view) wait for task completion.

detaileddescription.para: Unlike the rest of coio API, this implementation doesn't support timeouts or cancellation.
It follows the error reporting convention of the respective system calls, i.e. it doesn't throw exceptions either.
